combination: none: the components are reported separately; UNKNOWN measurement uncertainty prevents any total, and no independence assumption is made

within_cell_holdout.1rc: NOT_ASSESSABLE (12 cycle(s) outside the validated domain)

applicability.supported_regime: 2 A constant-current discharge plus rest, ~24 C ambient, cells of the NASA FY08Q4 batch within their first 30 discharges, SOC on the causal integrated-charge basis
applicability.transfer: cross-cell transfer (B0006) FAILED the preregistered acceptance for both models
unsupported: any other current, including pulses and charge
parameter values as physical constants of the cell

initial_state.reason: after a CV charge v_p0 carries the charge direction (negative under the positive-discharge convention); either sign of a 20 mA x R1 polarization is immaterial (objective ratios 0.9994 and 1.0006)

input_reconstruction.reason: turning ~19 s current samples into a piecewise-constant input leaves the load switch time unknown within one sample: the forward hold changes the objective by a factor 1.337 and moves R1 by +25 %. This is an input (measurement-sampling) uncertainty, not numerical discretization, and it is never NOT_APPLICABLE for measured profiles

measurement.evidence_required: a calibration certificate (or manufacturer accuracy specification bound to the actual instruments and ranges used) for voltage, current, temperature and time, or an independent co-located reference measurement of the same records
measurement.reason: NASA describes the voltmeter / ammeter / thermocouple suite but states no calibrated per-sample uncertainty or traceability for these records; a sensor description is not a calibrated uncertainty

model_form.reason: held-out 1RC residual RMSE is 79x and 41x the propagated parameter band half-width, and the residuals are strongly autocorrelated (lag-1 0.92, 0.76): the error is structured model-form and state error (OCV/resistance confounding, end-of-discharge knee, rest tail beyond one time constant), not noise. With measurement uncertainty UNKNOWN the discrepancy cannot be separated from it, so no discrepancy term is admitted; it is never zero

numerical.reason: the update is exact for piecewise-constant current; agreement with an independent adaptive ODE integration is below 1e-9 V and the fitting transcription equals the route below 1e-12 V (tests); float rounding only

parameter.reason: the parameters are NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: the cycle bootstrap varies near-replicate cycles and cannot see the OCV-resistance confounding (flat profiles) or the switch-time dependence (forward hold moves R1 by +25 %). Propagated jointly (no independence assumption), the band covers only a small fraction of the held-out measurements, so it must not be presented as the prediction uncertainty
